title: Atomic formula types
statement: For a type $S$ and a natural number $k$, define the type of atoms to consist of an atom carrying a table selector from $S$ with parameter $k$, a work-tape index, and an auxiliary work-tape index, together with the distinct atoms for length, the two all-zero tests, the auxiliary-zero test, the index-zero test, the comparisons of the index with $N$, the test that the index equals $N+1$, and the input-bit test.
caveat: The meanings and types of TabSel, TW, AW, and the symbols N and the index are not supplied in the upstream definitions, so their intended mathematical interpretation is unclear.
